summary: Full backend (pytest, 11/11 passing) + frontend (Playwright, mobile viewport 375x667) validation for BiteRep. All backend /api/* endpoints work end-to-end: anonymous auth is idempotent per device_id, Mifflin-St Jeor onboarding matches exact expected values (BMR 1780, maintenance 2634, adjustment 440, target 2194, protein 176g for 80kg/180cm/30yo male/moderate/lose_fat/0.5%), Open Food Facts search returns 20 de-duped yogurt hits with kcal_100g > 0, food/weight/workout CRUD persist correctly, summary aggregates by meal, adaptive-tdee returns null with a reason when no data, Buddy SSE streams data: chunks terminated by [DONE], and photo-food AI returns {items:[...]} JSON for a real food JPEG. Frontend Expo web preview boots to Welcome, full 9-step onboarding completes and lands on Home with correct 2194 kcal ring + macro cards + 4 meal sections + date strip; food search 'yogurt' returns real OFF results, tapping one opens the log sheet and confirming logs 'Yogurt 92 kcal' under Breakfast (0/549 -> 92/549) and totals update (92/2194 kcal, 4g P, 13g C, 3g F); Buddy tab sends a message and receives a streamed reply visibly.

issues: Streamed reply shows 'HeyTester' with no space between greeting and name (cosmetic – LLM output only, system prompt could add a comma after the greeting instruction)

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' (non-blocking, RN Web deprecation)
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents (non-blocking)

action_items: Optional: replace deprecated shadow* / pointerEvents props with boxShadow / style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web warnings
Optional cosmetic: adjust Buddy system prompt to avoid 'HeyTester' concatenation (e.g., 'Address the user as {name},')
critical_code_review_comments: server.py all endpoints exclude Mongo _id via projection or pop – good
compute_targets: activity 'moderate' uses 1.48 (slightly non-standard vs 1.55); acceptable per app design
photo-food endpoint returns raw model JSON via regex extraction – robust enough but could add pydantic validation of items schema for stricter contract
buddy_chat yields SSE '[ERROR] ...' inline on failure with 200 status – frontend must inspect chunk content; acceptable but consider a distinct SSE event name

success_rate.frontend: 100% (onboarding, home, food search+log, buddy SSE all verified)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_* device_ids and TEST_* food/weight/workout log entries created via pytest; not cleaned but namespaced with TEST_ prefix and isolated per anonymous user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: https://calorie-tracker-1048.preview.emergentagent.com. All endpoints require X-User-Id header (obtain via POST /api/auth/anon with {device_id:'TEST_xxx'}). Buddy is SSE: parse chunks 'data: <text>\n\n' until 'data: [DONE]'. Photo-food needs a real (non-blank) JPEG >500 bytes; picsum.photos/id/292/400/300.jpg is a working food photo in the sandbox. Frontend session is fresh per Playwright run (no persisted AsyncStorage), so run onboarding inline before testing tabs; navigate to /buddy, /trends, /profile via direct URL after onboarding completes.
